name: Laboratory of Toxicant Analysis, Institute of Pharmacology and Toxicology
supervisors: Academy of Military Medical Sciences (PLA Academy of Military Science)

evidence.summary: The OPCW lists the Laboratory of Toxicant Analysis as part of the Institute of Pharmacology and Toxicology of the Academy of Military Medical Sciences, which belongs to the PLA’s Academy of Military Science, an important PLA research institution in Xinhua’s description. The laboratory is one of the OPCW’s designated laboratories for analysing chemical-weapons samples. The US Commerce Department added it to the Military End-User List in December 2020, having determined that it is a military end user.
It belongs to the PLA’s Academy of Military Science through the Academy of Military Medical Sciences.
